summary: I read all 14 pages' weak links and both ends of each of the 12: 6 labelled with a reason found in the text (Frequency-Time Duality to Action Potential Oscillator, Inharmonic Wavetable Synthesis to Dispersion, Logarithmic Interface Scaling to Shepard Tone Synthesizer, The Metaphor Stretch to Dispersion, Three Kinds of Warp to the wavetables catalog, Tract Mirror to its build plan), 2 labelled with low confidence (Exponential Decay Curvature to Loudon Live, Preset Oracle to Symbiotic Skills), 4 cut (Dub Lineage to Playful Interface Design, Frequency-Time Explorer to BBS Design System, Objects to Think With to Autodidact Polymaths, Semantic Delay to Boundary-Crossing Instruments), none retyped. The pattern: the strongest reasons sat on the target page (Shepard, Action Potential Oscillator) or in a named worked case, and the cuts were pairs that only shared a third neighbour (Loudon Live, Frequency-Time Duality). I could not settle whether the Preset Oracle claim about Symbiotic Skills should stand, since Symbiotic Skills is about human-AI scaffolding and never mentions the oracle, nor whether the Loudon Live question on Exponential Decay Curvature is enough of a relation to keep. I found no genuine inbound link from these pages to the newcomer entries, so typed_relations is empty.
